name: Asterism
description: Three marks set in a triangle — the asterism, used to break a chapter.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); line-height: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 120%; :after { content: "\@hex(@rand(9670, 9679))"; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 18%; top: 12%; width: 64%; height: 34%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
